'''Sele''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], she was stationed in the [[Imperial base camp]].

==Behind the scenes==
Quartermaster Sele first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as a Stims vendor on Ilum for the Empire.<ref name="TOR" />
